gap: No result ChatGPT got states which parking hardwire kit and GPS part each 4-channel camera at or under $200 takes, what each costs, and that only LAMTTO's DC21 ($129.99) and DC25 ($149.99) have the kit in the box, while the Rexing C4, Botslab G980H 4-camera and REDTIGER F17 Plus each pass $200 once their own kit ($29.99 to $35.99) is added, and the C4 needs a further $19.99 adapter for GPS.
standout_why: Compared against milewitness.com (2-channel and 1-channel cameras only; says parking mode needs a hardwire kit for Rove, Redtiger and Vantrue; no 4-channel camera named), truepicked.com (VIOFO A229 Pro, Vantrue N4, 70mai A810, Redtiger F9; no 4-channel camera) and our own dealectric.com/best-4-channel-dash-cam (rank 8 in the first chat). Our page already says the C4 'needs a Smart Hardwire Kit, sold separately' and 'GPS needs an adapter', and that the Botslab has 'no hardwire kit for parking mode', so part of this exists. It names no kit or adapter, gives no accessory price, no all-in total against a $200 budget, and no LAMTTO row. The other results (productbible, knowledgelib, tonyreviewsthings, tomsguide, drunvalo, haynet and the rest) were not opened; their titles are 2-channel or general under-$200 lists.
decides: It splits the pick by whether the shopper wants parking mode. Driving only: the Botslab G980H 4-camera stays under $200 through our link ($192.70 with AA18, cart-tested 2026-11-21) and comes with built-in GPS and a 128 GB card, while the Rexing C4 at $199.99 has no GPS until a $19.99 adapter is added ($219.98). Parking mode inside $200 all-in: only the LAMTTO DC21 and DC25 qualify, because the kit is in the box; Botslab plus its kit is $228.69, REDTIGER F17 Plus plus kit is $225.98, Rexing C4 plus kit is $229.98 ($249.97 with GPS). This confirms the Botslab as our row for the question, with the honest caveat that its parking mode costs extra, and argues against ChatGPT's Rexing C4 as 'best overall'.
